<function name="GetSurfaceArea" parent="PhysObj" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns the surface area of the physics object in source-units². Or nil if the PhysObj is a generated sphere or box.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number|nil">The surface area or `nil` if the PhysObj is a generated sphere or box.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
